methodology: financials (revenue/income) are gross per game day (24 turns) in ANCHOR units, converted x USD anchor rate for display. balanceSheet (market cap/cash/debt) is in HOME-CURRENCY units, converted via live forex. marginPct = operatingIncome / totalRevenue * 100. growth = split-adjusted tape change over trailing 30 turns (game 6M uses internal snapshots; figures converge for steady traders). Threshold checks run on USD market cap. Corps that 404 are flagged alive:false with frozen last-known figures and excluded from sums until they reappear.
